anomalies.expected: The specification's EPD-driver matching table lists C1 in the 'default 1 µF / 25 V' group (C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V), i.e. the intended part is 1 µF / 25 V. The build's C1 is 10× smaller in capacitance and rated 16 V instead of 25 V.

anomalies.impact: C1 is the bulk decoupling capacitor on the EPD power-switch rail that feeds the boost converter (L1) and the panel VDD/VDDIO. Replacing the intended 1 µF with 0.1 µF removes most of the charge reservoir on that rail, so during boost switching the rail can sag, causing e-paper refresh glitches or failed panel power-up; the 16 V rating is also below the 25 V called for by the reference design.
